svg.title: Precog SOC: attack forecast on a 3D network
svg.desc: Isometric network of six hosts in three zones. One host is compromised (red octahedron). Violet forecast cones point to the predicted next targets, strongest toward Web Server B at 74 percent, with a Contain button for it.
svg.text: and contain it before it happens.
